test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Book written by an author on his own life
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Autobiography"** refers to a book written by an author about their own life. (आत्मकथा)

 
 
• **Example:** Mahatma Gandhi's "The Story of My Experiments with Truth" is a famous** autobiography.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Autobiography**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Biography **(जीवनी): A detailed description of a person's life written by someone else.

 
 
• **Example:** "Steve Jobs" by Walter Isaacson is a well-known biography.
 
 
 
• **Historiography **(इतिहासलेखन): The study of historical writing or the writing of history.
 
 
• **Example:** The historiography of World War II has evolved over the decades.
 
 
 
• **Anthology **(संकलन): A published collection of poems or other pieces of writing.
 
 
• **Example:** "The Norton Anthology of English Literature" is a popular anthology used in many literature courses.
